subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should ClawHub land this Official/profile-state label vocabulary now, or wait to consolidate it with the adjacent feed, publisher-state, and follow-discovery stack?
rationale: The PR does not just change copy; it adds durable spec language for trust and discovery labels while adjacent account feed and publisher state work is still open, so automation cannot choose the long-term product vocabulary.

options.title: Accept this narrow vocabulary now
options.body: Merge can proceed after real browser proof if maintainers are comfortable making these labels the current product direction while later stack slices fill in missing facts.

options.title: Consolidate with the stack first
options.body: Keep this draft open until adjacent feed, publisher state, and follow-discovery PRs settle the vocabulary together.

options.title: Limit to copy-only UI polish
options.body: Ask the contributor to drop or narrow the durable spec additions and keep this PR to the current Official wording and profile labels only.

recommendation.title: Accept this narrow vocabulary now
recommendation.body: Merge can proceed after real browser proof if maintainers are comfortable making these labels the current product direction while later stack slices fill in missing facts.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current-history connection to the official-publisher policy, badge wording, and profile UI baseline this PR changes.
